note.completionDefinition: reader-visible official paid note page verified with exact title, expected price, paid boundary and dedicated cover

operationalState.debtRule: Only strict reader-visible verification decrements paid debt or counts toward the paid daily target.
operationalState.fallbackPolicy: Finish Sep 9 free NOTE and BOOTH carryover first; do not reactivate any strict-verified Sep 9 paid NOTE.

freeAcquisitionExperiment.strictFreePublicationDefinition: reader-visible official note page verified with exact title, free state and dedicated cover image
freeAcquisitionExperiment.separationRule: Free publications never decrement paid note debt and never replace the paid 5/day strict floor.

BOOTH.completionDefinition: buyer-visible official BOOTH product page verified with exact title, expected price, downloadable-product state and purchase/cart path

operationalState.debtRule: Only strict buyer-visible verification decrements BOOTH debt or counts toward the daily floor.
operationalState.fallbackPolicy: Process Sep 9 BOOTH carryover first and reconcile exact-title pages before any create.

currentDay.priority: Clear prior-day strict debt before activating today's fully materialized targets.

rules: Paid daily targets are hard minimums and are not silently reduced for expected-profit optimization.
Carryover survives date changes and PC power-off until strict public verification.
Do not count queue insertion, commits, local exit 0, editor/admin URLs, or invented URLs as publication.
Free NOTE never replaces or decrements the paid NOTE floor.
Before retrying an ambiguous publication, reconcile existing exact-title public pages to prevent duplicates.
Canonical Windows root is C:\SIDEHUSTLE_AUTO; do not create daily scattered ZIP/CMD runners.
